caption:
Log a fetch response the quick way in your machine coding round and the page breaks the moment you add the log.

Look at the card. A response body is a stream. res.json() reads it to the end, and once it's read, it's gone. The second res.json() throws a TypeError (Chrome says "body stream already read"), so data is never set and nothing renders.

Fix: read the body once into a variable, then log the variable. If you really need two reads, call res.clone() before the first one.

The same rule applies to res.text() and res.blob(). Any two reads of one body fail.

Source: MDN, Response.bodyUsed and Response.clone().
